description: This file 'handle_set.c' handles processing USP SetRequest messages, including expanding path expressions, managing transactions, and generating detailed response messages with success and failure statuses. It interacts with various system components such as path resolver, transaction manager, and protobuf message structures for response construction.

classes.name: set_expr_info_t
classes.description: Structure used to store information about each set expression, including the requested path, resolved object paths, parameter settings, and associated error information.

methods.name: void MSG_HANDLER_HandleSet(Usp__Msg * usp,char * controller_endpoint,mtp_conn_t * mtpc)
methods.description: Handles incoming USP Set messages and delegates to grouped handling.

methods.name: void Grouped_HandleSet(Usp__Msg * usp,char * controller_endpoint,mtp_conn_t * mtpc)
methods.description: Main processing function for a Set message, including expansion, transaction handling, and response creation.

methods.name: void ExpandSetPathExpression(Usp__Set__UpdateObject * up,set_expr_info_t * si,group_set_vector_t * gsv)
methods.description: Expands a specific object update expression into individual object paths and parameters, resolving paths and preparing the group set vector.

methods.name: Usp__Msg * ProcessSet_AllowPartialFalse(char * msg_id,set_expr_info_t * set_expr_info,int num_set_expr,group_set_vector_t * gsv)
methods.description: Processes a set request where partial updates are not allowed; aborts on first error.

methods.name: Usp__Msg * CreateErrRespFromFailedSetParams(char * msg_id,group_set_vector_t * gsv,int first_failure,int last_param_index)
methods.description: Creates an error response message reporting failed required parameters.

methods.name: Usp__Msg * ProcessSet_AllowPartialTrue(char * msg_id,set_expr_info_t * set_expr_info,int num_set_expr,group_set_vector_t * gsv)
methods.description: Processes a set request where partial updates are permitted, handling successes and individual failures.

methods.name: void ProcessSet_AllowPartialTrue_Expression(char * msg_id,Usp__SetResp * set_resp,set_expr_info_t * si,group_set_vector_t * gsv)
methods.description: Processes each path expression independently when partial updates are allowed.

methods.name: void PopulateSetResp_OperFailure(Usp__SetResp * set_resp,set_expr_info_t * si,group_set_vector_t * gsv)
methods.description: Populates the response message with failure details for a set expression.

methods.name: void PopulateOperFailure_UpdatedInstFailure(Usp__SetResp__UpdatedObjectResult__OperationStatus__OperationFailure * oper_failure,set_expr_info_t * si,int obj_index,group_set_vector_t * gsv)
methods.description: Fills in details of the failed object instance and parameters within an operation failure.

methods.name: void PopulateSetResp_OperSuccess(Usp__SetResp * set_resp,set_expr_info_t * si,group_set_vector_t * gsv)
methods.description: Populates the response message with success details for a set expression.

methods.name: void DestroySetExprInfo(set_expr_info_t * set_expr_info,int num_set_expr)
methods.description: Frees memory associated with set expression info array.

methods.name: Usp__Msg * CreateSetResp(char * msg_id)
methods.description: Creates an empty set response message.

methods.name: Usp__SetResp__UpdatedObjectResult__OperationStatus__OperationFailure * AddSetResp_OperFailure(Usp__SetResp * set_resp,char * path,int err_code,char * err_msg)
methods.description: Adds a failure entry to the response, including nested object failures.

methods.name: Usp__SetResp__UpdatedInstanceFailure * AddOperFailure_UpdatedInstFailure(Usp__SetResp__UpdatedObjectResult__OperationStatus__OperationFailure * oper_failure,char * path)
methods.description: Creates and adds a failure record for a specific object instance.

methods.name: Usp__SetResp__ParameterError * AddUpdatedInstFailure_ParamErr(Usp__SetResp__UpdatedInstanceFailure * updated_inst_failure,char * path,int err_code,char * err_msg)
methods.description: Adds a parameter error entry to an object failure.

methods.name: Usp__SetResp__UpdatedObjectResult__OperationStatus__OperationSuccess * AddSetResp_OperSuccess(Usp__SetResp * set_resp,char * path)
methods.description: Adds a success entry for an object to the response.

methods.name: Usp__SetResp__UpdatedInstanceResult * AddOperSuccess_UpdatedInstRes(Usp__SetResp__UpdatedObjectResult__OperationStatus__OperationSuccess * oper_success,char * path)
methods.description: Adds an instance result to a success response.

methods.name: Usp__SetResp__UpdatedInstanceResult__UpdatedParamsEntry * AddUpdatedInstRes_ParamsEntry(Usp__SetResp__UpdatedInstanceResult * updated_inst_result,char * key,char * value)
methods.description: Adds a successfully set parameter to an object instance.

methods.name: Usp__SetResp__ParameterError * AddUpdatedInstRes_ParamErr(Usp__SetResp__UpdatedInstanceResult * updated_inst_result,char * path,int err_code,char * err_msg)
methods.description: Adds a parameter error to an object instance result.

ctags.name: err_code
ctags.pattern: /^    int err_code;           \/\/ error code if path resolution failed for this requested path$/

ctags.name: err_msg
ctags.pattern: /^    char *err_msg;          \/\/ error message if path resolution failed for this requested path$/

ctags.name: index
ctags.pattern: /^    int index;              \/\/ start index of parameters in set group vector for this requeste/

ctags.name: num_params
ctags.pattern: /^    int num_params;         \/\/ number of parameters to set in each resolved object$/

ctags.name: param_settings
ctags.pattern: /^    Usp__Set__UpdateParamSetting **param_settings;  \/\/ Pointer to vector of names of parameter/

ctags.name: requested_path
ctags.pattern: /^    char *requested_path;   \/\/ Pointer to path expression (owned by USP Set Request message).$/

ctags.name: resolved_objs
ctags.pattern: /^    str_vector_t resolved_objs; \/\/ vector of object paths that have been resolved$/
